column7: Typo – You may consider to make this a Global Correction using the target search: " īddaś"  ——becomes—–  " īdṛś" • the initial space surrounding the target search " īddaś" is required to avoid ativyāpti, which I am sure will delight Andhrabharati, by my mention. The form: " īddaś" in every single occurrence can only be this: " īdṛś" – There is no other possible correct combination of these letters.
Typo – Please note that we have added the "missing" accent for the joy of Andhrabharati.
